en: The postcard features a printed portrait of Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy (1809–1847) on the left, with a sketch and handwritten notes to the right. Above the drawing, it is labeled 'Frühlingsfest der Detmolder Damenliedertafel.' The reverse side shows handwritten text in German, a stamp from the Deutsches Reich, and a postal mark from Detmold dated 1909. There is also a blue stamp for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
